La musique de fond de l'écran d'accueil PS5 pour GTA VI est en train de me hype très fort alors que le jeu est dispo dans 9 jours

GTA 6 HAS OFFICIALLY GONE GOLD.

Development is complete.

GTA 6 has gone gold!

Take-Two CEO, Strauss Zelnick confirms Rockstar has finished development during the earnings call:

“They’ve done their very best work.”

And for the first time, he openly said the game won’t be delayed again in an interview with IGN.

Ludwig expects GTA 6 to get some “disappointing” reactions during launch week

He believes years of GTA RP, mods, and enhanced PC experiences may have inflated expectations
